About 14 Craigie St Unit 2

Two bedroom apartment in Spring Hill, Somerville. Great location with close Proximity to Porter Square. Great layout in this two bedroom, one bathroom apartment. Large, full kitchen with pantry. Common laundry in building complex as well. Steps to many great restaurants, cafe's, shopping, and everything the city has to offer. Close and convenient proximity to MBTA for all your commuting needs.

About Spring
Hill
Spring Hill, located between Union Square and Porter Square, is a residential and artsy Somerville neighborhood with triple-decker streetscapes and pocket parks. The neighborhood’s character concentrates around the Beacon Street corridor near Somerville Avenue, where corner cafés, small galleries, and late-night bites keep the sidewalks in motion. A mix of Queen Anne details, brick apartment blocks, and converted industrial spaces shapes the streetscape. The Somerville Theatre and Bow Market set a cultural cadence with repertory screens, pop-up retail, and food stalls. The Community Path threads past murals and bike traffic, linking daily errands to green space. Spring Hill Playground and nearby Prospect Hill Park add courts, lawns, and skyline views.

Provided by Walk Score and Local Logic
